title: Other inspections.
officialText:
In addition to the inspections specified above, the commissioner is authorized to make or require other
inspections of any construction work to ascertain compliance with the provisions of this code and other laws that are enforced by
the department.
**110.3.7 Tenant protection plan compliance inspections. For buildings undergoing work for which a tenant protection
plan is required by Article 120 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code, inspections shall be made by the department to
determine compliance with the tenant protection plan.
*Section 110.3.7 was amended by Local Law 154 of 2017. This law has an effective date of December 28, 2017.
**Section 110.3.7 was amended by Local Law 106 of 2019. This law has an effective date of March 8, 2020.
